messages:
maria (PM): quick sync — Q3 hosted API: two pilot customers want a demo-ready integration by end of month. we need to pick a minimal scope. options: 1) embeddings SLA + caching 2) low-latency rerank path 3) per-route cost controls. thoughts?
kevin (eng): my vote is embeddings SLA + prefix caching first. biggest infra lift is predictable tail latency for embeddings at scale. caching buys latency + cost wins.
olivia (sre): agree with caching. note: can’t guarantee 99.9% p99 without dedicated pools or isolating priority traffic. we can do canary on dedicated nodes though.
nina (cs): customer A insists on p95 < 120ms for embeddings on 1k qps. customer B cares more about rerank consistency (ordering vs latency). both would sign if we hit their demo bars.
sam (design): API surface question — do we expose new cache TTL param or keep server-side only? for demos, simpler surface preferred. maybe server-side with feature flag.
kevin (eng): server-side flag + per-customer config sounds right. implementation sketch: KV cache + LRU, TTL default 2m, override via customer profile. rough config: `cache:{enabled:true, default_ttl_ms:120000}`
pradeep (ml): need evaluation criteria: embedding recall delta <= 1% with caching, and rerank rank-stability metric (kendall tau) > 0.92 vs baseline. also capture output drift on quantized model variant if we use it.
maria (PM): good call. launch criteria proposal: 1) p95 embeddings <= 120ms on customer load in canary, 2) recall delta <= 1% on curated eval set, 3) feature flag + ops playbook for rollback, 4) clear cost estimate per qps.
kevin (eng): blockers: infra quota for dedicated nodes, infra-automation for per-customer config, and a small SDK change for seamless TTL override. estimate 3 devs 2 weeks if we get capacity.
nina (cs): I'll prioritize customers for the canary and line up Sandboxes. can run demo scripts and feedback session.
olivia (sre): SLO/alert plan: create p95/p99 dashboards, auto-fallback to lower-cost model variant on p99 breach, and pager threshold at sustained: p99 > 300ms for 5m.
sam (design): for the demo UX: show a toggle "demo-optimized" that enables caching and consistent rerank; simple copy explaining tradeoffs.
maria (PM): decisions: embeddings SLA + caching is MVP. rerank improvements moved to follow-up sprint unless we can parallelize. action items: kevin infra plan + ETA, pradeep eval sets + pass/fail scripts, nina onboard canary customers, olivia SLO dashboard.
kevin (eng): starting infra doc now -> will post deploy plan by EOD tomorrow.
nina (cs): pinging Acme & Pax, will confirm sandbox times.
pradeep (ml): uploading eval buckets to shared drive, will link here when ready.
deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: `canary/emb-cache-v1` -> 2025-08-07T03:20:00Z (tentative).
maria (PM): thanks — follow-up huddle Friday 10am PT to triage blockers. :thumbsup:
